'''Gareth Nawling''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Thaereian military]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Nawling, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], was a member of a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] under the command of [[Lorwin Derlynn]]. He saw evidence of the Thaereians transporting their prisoners to die in the arena abaord the [[Burnout (space station)|Burnout]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] and knew that the Thaereian military commanders were feeding their troops misinformation, so he considered deserting, but his loyalty to Derlynn made him stay. During the Clone Wars, he and the rest of the squad were sent to occupy an abandoned [[Cularin Militia]] [[Cularin Militia asteroid base|base]] in the [[Cularin asteroid belt]]. The [[Heroes of Cularin]] arrived there, intending to deliver supplies to the Militia, so the squad tried to make them surrender to them. However, the heroes tried to convince Nawling and his comrades to defect to the Militia instead.
